business_problem: Large omnichannel businesses have to manage an enormous amount of information. Combining data from physical spaces, like camera footage for security, with data from digital channels, like customer interactions, creates a portfolio of deeply valuable insights.
solution_summary: Whale integrates Gemini multimodal AI to help enterprises evolve from informational black boxes to intelligent workspaces. Large omnichannel businesses have to manage an enormous amount of information. Combining data from physical spaces, like camera footage for security, with data from digital channels, like customer interactions, creates a portfolio of deeply valuable insights. However, collecting and collating that information is highly manual, and the data is often fragmented across many tools. Whale is an AI platform built to run end-to-end enterprise operations. Through its connected solutions —SpaceSight, Echo, Harbor, Lume, and Alivia—Whale provides a unified solution that enables global brands to see, hear, remember, express, and think through complex operational challenges.

solution_components.name: Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform
solution_components.role: Coordinates multi-agent workflows, tool calling, and governed automation across the application.

solution_components.name: Vertex AI
solution_components.role: Hosts and orchestrates machine learning and generative AI capabilities inside the solution.

business_outcome: Integrated multimodal Gemini models into Whale solutions; Accelerated model deployment and tuning with Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform; Automate data ingestion to inform operational decisions; Offer real-time coaching to sales teams.
metrics: The company’s unified AI architecture also helps Whale optimize AI response speeds and reduce latency for its customers. This increased speed has led to higher user engagement and higher completion rates across its product workflows. For end users, this all translates to smoother natural-language interactions, enabling store operations and sales teams to automate 24/7 compliance audits and access real-time coaching at a moment's notice.
